annotator: claude (single annotator; second human review pending)
rationale: Added (inert) release pipelines for stack-* crates and @cipherstash/auth. The linux-x64-musl binary was built on the Ubuntu runner with musl-tools and linked glibc, so it would not load on musl systems. Caught by the follow-up before publish from this repo.

known_defects.description: musl target built on a glibc host links glibc; binary fails to load on musl
known_defects.mechanism: cross build with musl-tools on Ubuntu; no C-library check on the output
known_defects.match_criteria: Scenario identifies that the musl (or any cross-compiled) native binary may be built/linked incorrectly for its target platform and nothing verifies the output binary's libc/platform.
